Self.Wiki: A sample point for the offline automatic draw-group generation (Nightreign calls the type AutoDrawGroupSample). Retail points are all named AutoDrawGroupPoint_NNN and appear only in legacy dungeons. The game never reads it.

UnkT00.Wiki: -1, or a value that is always below the map's collision count (362 of 362 retail points), so probably the index of a collision. Never read by the game.
